description.html: Arcadia EarthPro-Ca is a high-quality, finely ground calcium powder. The composition is simple: 100% calcium carbonate, with no vitamin D3 or other additives. The manufacturer describes it as an easy-to-digest natural calcium used alongside the rest of the EarthPro line to top up calcium day to day.

Calcium is stored in the bones and released into the blood for muscle function. Arcadia stresses that calcium is only part of the picture: the animal also needs proper UV lighting to make vitamin D3 and use the calcium from its food. That is why EarthPro-Ca goes hand in hand with a good UVB lamp.

Put insects in a bag with a little powder and shake gently until lightly coated, or sprinkle the powder over vegetables for herbivores. EarthPro-Ca can be combined with EarthPro-A, which the EarthPro programme uses at every feed. The pouch reseals, so the powder stays dry.
Suitable for lizards, geckos, tortoises, chameleons and amphibians. UVB lamps and other supplements are in our equipment range.
